# SoulsRandomizers

SoulsRandomizers has routines for randomizing FromSoftware games and otherwise adding
fun and/or challenging ways of replaying them. Find the mod releases on Nexus Mods:

- Elden Ring: https://www.nexusmods.com/eldenring/mods/428
- DS3: https://www.nexusmods.com/darksouls3/mods/361
- Sekiro: https://www.nexusmods.com/sekiro/mods/543

## Licensing and contributions

SoulsRandomizers is published under a [source-available license](LICENSE.md) which
means you can use the source code for reference purposes, but creating and distributing
your own releases or bundling randomizer with other software is not permitted. Randomizer
is *not* free (libre) software or open source in FSF's terminology, but it will always
be free (gratis) to use. See the license for further reasoning for this and detailed terms.

From 2019 to 2026, contributions to randomizer were not accepted, but they now are under
[contributing guidelines](https://github.com/thefifthmatt/SoulsRandomizers/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md)
in order for other modding projects to interoperate with randomizer or to make personal
changes more widely available, so long as you are okay with the license terms for it.
By default this would be under the [Contributor License Agreement (CLA)](https://cla-assistant.io/thefifthmatt/SoulsRandomizers)
but some contributions can alternatively be made to freely licensed dependencies.

notes.text:
[Setup guide](<https://github.com/fswap/Archipelago/blob/er/worlds/eldenring/docs/en_setup_guide.md>)
[Game info](<https://github.com/fswap/Archipelago/blob/er/worlds/eldenring/docs/en_Elden_Ring.md>)

This version has minor fixes (see below), though it is still an **unstable alpha**. Avoid using it in runs with other people unless they are okay with these kinds of issues coming up.

Changes
- Support interactive location maps in [Universal Tracker](https://github.com/FarisTheAncient/Archipelago/releases) with live position tracking (requires UT 0.3.8). See the setup guide above for more details.
- Show in-game map icons for unchecked priority locations.
- Add option to prevent heavy load, Heavy Trap which forces heavy load, and allow opening map in combat (except during boss fights).
- Add option to split Imbued Sword Keys into 4 different keys for each destination, on by default.
- Support random goal bosses, shown in the spoiler log.
- Support excluding any region in `exclude_locations`. Check the [Region Guide](https://github.com/fswap/Archipelago/blob/er/worlds/eldenring/docs/en_region_guide.md) for a full list.
- Avoid placing remembrances in shops.

Fixes
- Work around progression balancing not working for Archipelago priority locations by not marking Elden Ring priority locations as priority for Archipelago.
- Other worlds' `progression_deprioritized` items like puzzle pieces and SM64 stars can't place off priority now.
- Move Wyndham Catacombs from Mt. Gelmir in logic to Altus where it is actually accessible.
- Include all chests in the "Chest" priority group and add "Rise" to `exclude_locations`
- Don't count all items blocked by a boss as boss rewards.
- Prevent Bell Bearing soft logic from applying in UT.
- Make Ymir give the Hole-Laden Necklace check even if it was already used.
- Enemy randomizer: prevent Bayle in Temple of Eiglay and fix "unknown target segment phasedisable" error.

**What to download**:
- EldenRingArchipelagoRandomizer.zip includes the client, and also includes eldenring.apworld and pre-generated yaml files.
- ERMaps.zip can be used with Universal Tracker (at least version 0.3.8) and is derived from in-game map assets.
